terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.description: The conditions for learning and participating in Arxatec Academy.

access.title: Access to the platform
access.body: Arxatec Academy offers free courses on law and technology. Some lessons are open to everyone and others require an account. By registering, you accept these conditions. Our privacy policy explains how we handle your information.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Provide accurate information and keep your details up to date. Protect your credentials and tell us if you notice access you do not recognize. Some actions, such as posting comments, require email verification.

content.title: Using the content
content.body: Courses, videos and materials are provided for your personal learning. Respect the rights of Arxatec, instructors and other authors. Redistributing or commercially exploiting materials requires the rights holder’s permission, except where permitted by law.

community.title: Participation and comments
community.body: Participate respectfully and keep your contributions relevant to the lesson. Avoid advertising, offensive messages and confidential information about clients or others. We may moderate content that breaks these rules and restrict abusive use of the platform.

learning.title: Scope of the training
learning.body: The content is educational and does not replace professional advice for a specific case. Certificates reflect completion of course requirements; they are not official degrees or professional licenses.

changes.title: Availability and changes
changes.body: We may update content and carry out maintenance that temporarily affects access. Changes to these conditions will be published here with an updated date. These conditions do not limit your rights under applicable law.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we use and look after your information in Arxatec Academy.

data.title: Information we handle
data.body: Arxatec manages your account information: name, email, city and, if you add them, organization and profile photo. We also store enrollments, progress, exam results, certificates and comments. If you request course updates or suggest a topic, we record the information you submit in that form.

purpose.title: How we use it
purpose.body: We use this information to provide access, save your learning progress, issue certificates, respond to requests and protect the platform. Verification and recovery messages help manage your account. Course updates relate to subscriptions you request; you can write to us to unsubscribe.

public.title: Information you share publicly
public.body: Comments are public and display your name, photo and organization when available. Anyone with a certificate verification link can see the participant’s name and the completed course. Avoid posting client details or information you do not want to share.

providers.title: Third-party services
providers.body: Academy relies on hosting, storage and email services. If you choose Google sign-in or load a YouTube video, these providers also process information under their own policies and may do so outside Peru. See Arxatec’s general policies for further details.

storage.title: Session and retention
storage.body: Your browser stores your session and preferences such as language and theme. You can sign out and manage this data through your browser. We retain information needed to provide the service and meet applicable legal obligations. You can update your details or delete your account from your profile.

rights.title: Your rights and requests
rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion or object to the processing of your data, and withdraw consent where applicable, under Peru’s Law No. 29733 and its regulations. Write to us with your request; we may verify your identity. You may also contact Peru’s National Authority for Personal Data Protection.
